en:
We now begin our counteroffensive against the mysterious enemy forces
spread across the Earth Sphere. First, as piloting practice, run a
recon-in-force into enemy-held territory. Take a GM into the Jungle Base
area, engage the patrols there, and assess the enemy's strength in the area.

Before full-scale combat with the mysterious enemy begins, run
another recon-in-force against the enemy patrols in the Jungle
Base area to gather more intel. This time you'll operate with
another squad member. Take two GMs into the area, engage
the reinforced enemy patrols, and wipe them out together.

At last, a full-scale counteroffensive against the mysterious enemy has begun
across the Earth Sphere! Our "Gundam Breaker Squad" joins as a mobile
reserve, first backing the main force retaking the facility in the Jungle Base
area. Our first official battle: wipe out the forces guarding enemy territory.
Weaken their defense line and light the beacon of our counterattack.
Destroy the large machine deep in the war zone

The first battle of the counteroffensive went far better than expected, but
it also told the enemy we mean to fight back. The enemy has begun
sending more forces to every war zone; in the Jungle Base area, a new
high-energy signal, likely a large machine, has been detected. No more
holding back. Force through the enemy front, find the target and destroy it!

HG Beam Rifle (Mk-II) (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Javelin (Giant Main Machine)

A bonus mission with special settings. This time, head to a battlefield
in "a world other than this one" and train in combat against enemy
forces made up only of Zeon machines. There are also reports that a
powerful Unidentified Machine appears there. Be careful.

A mission with special settings. Head to a battlefield in "a world other
than this one" and train against enemy forces made up only of
Federation machines, including the "White Devil" itself: the HG
Gundam. A powerful Unidentified Machine is also reported. Be careful.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

Recon units in the Jungle Base area report that large numbers of
HG Gundams have been deployed there. Your enemy this time is a
pack of the legendary "White Devil". Wipe them out! Special traps
have been set in the war zone, and a powerful Unidentified Machine
is said to be hiding there. Expect the unexpected. Be very careful.

The enemy's true nature is still unknown, and its source remains
a mystery. So HQ has started an operation to collect and analyze
enemy data with intel- gathering probes: "Data Probes". This
mission is to defend a Data Probe set up in the war zone. Protect
it from enemy attacks until it finishes collecting enemy data.

[Special Mission] A massive unidentified enemy weapon has
appeared at sea outside the war zone! It's heading for a coastal city.
An allied carrier sent to stop it is under attack and in extreme danger.
Rush to the area, engage this massive weapon and destroy it!
Defeat the enemy forces around the war zone

Our squad has been asked to join operations in the desert area.
It's a scorching land over 50 degrees Celsius, and a fierce war zone
with powerful machines. Come fully equipped. This mission is to
assess the enemy's strength in the desert area. Engage the enemy
forces around the area and survey the situation in the war zone.

HG Prototype 9.1m Anti-Ship Sword (Main Machine)
HG Raketen Bazooka (Unidentified Machine)
Defeat the enemy forces around the war zone

Our squad has been asked to join operations in the mountain base area.
The base sits near the summit of a peak over 5000 m high, a frozen land
of glaciers, with many powerful enemy machines. Come fully equipped.
This mission: assess the enemy's strength in the mountain base area.
Engage the enemy forces around the area and survey the war zone.

HG MMP-80 Zaku Machine Gun (Main Machine)
HG 57mm High-Energy Beam Rifle (Main Machine)

A powerful main enemy machine has been confirmed deep in the
desert area. According to recon, it's a large black machine that
looks like the "White Devil", the Gundam. The enemy keeps growing
stronger, and we can't take our time either. Go in as the assault
unit, break through the front and hit the main machine beyond it.

HG ??? Parts (Unidentified Machine)
HG Combined Shield (Giant Main Machine)

An extremely powerful main enemy machine has been confirmed on the
summit of the mountain base area. The enemy seems to be building a
strong defense around it. To keep things from getting worse, it must be
destroyed now. This mission: push through no matter what and destroy it.
It's a forced operation, so expect the unexpected. Proceed with great care.

HG Beam Rifle (Z) (Giant Main Machine)
HG 57mm High-Energy Beam Rifle (Unidentified Machine)
Annihilate the enemy forces in the war zone

Having lost the Zeta Gundam, the core of its mountain base defense
line, the enemy is desperately rebuilding its defenses with jammers
and new machines. Wipe out the enemy forces dug in across the
jammed war zone. Expect fierce resistance, but now is our chance.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

HG Beam Scissors (Main Machine)
HG Beam Rifle (Z) (Unidentified Machine)
Annihilate the enemy forces in the war zone

The main force continuing to retake the Jungle Base area reports
a new, strange type of MG machine, unlike any seen so far. Our
mission this time: return to the Jungle Base area, engage and
destroy this new MG machine, and support the main force. This
strange new machine's abilities are still unknown. Be careful.

As if drawn in by the strange machine, the Astray, that appeared in the
Jungle Base area, many HG Astray series machines and a new large main
enemy machine have been sent into the war zone. Destroying this new main
machine is our objective. By its looks, it seems related to the Astray series,
but it appears to have special abilities none of them had. Be very careful.
<c04>HG Strike Gundam + IWSP Backpack</c> (Giant Main Machine)

A "Data Probe" that collects and analyzes enemy intel has drifted into
another dimension. On a battlefield in "a world other than this one",
defend it from enemy forces made up of machines with powerful
ranged weapons. Every enemy is strong, but taking their part runners
here should let you power up your machine further. Give it everything.
White Blade of a Crimson Soul

A strange main enemy machine with twin swords like katana has appeared in
the desert area too. At the same time, many HG and MG machines with large
swords seem to have joined the enemy forces holding the defense line. Wipe
out these forces and destroy the red main enemy machine beyond them.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

HG Gerbera Straight (Giant Main Machine)
HG Gerbera Straight/Tiger Pierce (Giant Main Machine)

Our units in the mountain base area report two high-energy signals,
likely PG machines, near the summit at the far end of the war zone.
The enemy has finally begun sending several main machines into
one war zone at once. This mission is to destroy these main enemy
machines. It'll be a tough fight, but I'm sure you can do it.

[Special Mission] We've received word that the enemy dropped a giant
mobile weapon into the mountain base area! The main force is engaging
it now, but against its high mobility and overwhelming firepower it's
struggling badly and is being forced to retreat. Rush to the summit of
the mountain base area and destroy the giant mobile weapon!
Defeat the enemy forces around the war zone

Our squad, with results far beyond HQ's expectations, has been asked to
join operations at a space fortress. This fortress can move on its own
with nuclear pulse engines; if it falls to the enemy, the worst could
happen to humanity on Earth. It's a top-priority defense target. First,
intel. Engage the enemy forces in the war zone and survey their strength.

HG Mega Gatling Gun (Main Machine)
HG Qubeley Parts (Unidentified Machine)

There are several powerful main enemy machines in the space fortress.
This mission: destroy one of them, the "Nu Gundam". Successor to the
"White Devil", the Gundam, it is well-balanced, high-performance and
uses all-range attacks with its fin funnels: an extremely powerful
enemy. But we can only move forward. Destroy it at all costs.

HG Nu Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
HG Sazabi Backpack (Unidentified Machine)
Defeat the enemy forces around the war zone

Our squad, with results far beyond HQ's expectations, has been asked
to join operations inside a space colony. This war zone is a front line
where the enemy has deployed many powerful machines, and it may
also hide the key to finding the enemy's still-unknown base. First, a
test. Engage the enemy forces and survey the situation in the war zone.

HG Twin Sword Rifle (Main Machine)
HG Heat Lance (Unidentified Machine)

Several powerful main enemy machines have been confirmed inside the
colony too. This mission is to destroy one of them: the "Unicorn Gundam".
A full psycho- frame machine known for the red glow across its body, it
combines overwhelming mobility with super-powerful shots from its
"Beam Magnum". It's expected to be a hard mission. Come fully equipped.

HG Beam Magnum (Giant Main Machine)
HG ??? Parts (Unidentified Machine)

To solve the enemy's mystery, an operation has begun to gather and
analyze intel with a Data Probe on the powerful enemy forces inside the
colony. Sensing this, the enemy has sent an assault force of heavily
armored and heavy-weapon machines to destroy the probe. Repel their
waves of attacks and defend the Data Probe until it finishes gathering intel.

HG Astray Blue Frame Second Revise Backpack (Main Machine)
HG Shiranui/Unryu (Unidentified Machine)

This mission: destroy a powerful main enemy machine that forms one
wing of the enemy attack force at the space fortress. The main force that
fought it reports creature-like wings on its back and a fighting style built
on fast, powerful shots from rifles in both hands. Against ranged machines,
reaction speed is your lifeline. Don't let your guard down for a moment.

HG Twin Buster Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
MG GM Parts (Giant Main Machine)

Units operating in the mountain base area report a new type of powerful
main enemy machine. It carries no ranged or melee weapons as its main
arms, and fights with very human martial arts moves using its fists and legs.
Rush to the mountain base area, engage this main machine and destroy it.
Many fighter-type machines also seem to be in its vanguard. Be careful.

Another round of intel gathering with a Data Probe will take place inside
the colony. The enemy has sent many high-mobility machines into the
colony, and collecting their data should allow more precise analysis. It'll
have a big effect on the whole war, but it'll be a hard fight. Defend the
Data Probe from the powerful enemy forces until it finishes gathering intel.

HG Freedom Gundam Leg (Main Machine)
HG Freedom Gundam Backpack (Main Machine)

A martial-arts fighter-type main enemy machine has appeared at the
space fortress too. It uses the same moves as the one at the mountain
base, but it's all in sinister black, and probably close to the enemy's
core. Head to the space fortress, engage it, and destroy it if you can!
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

Word has come that the enemy has sent a special assault force into the
space fortress. It's advancing from two directions: one group of the
fighter-type machines we've already fought, the other of dual-blade
machines including a new black one. A separate, unidentified Gundam type
is also reported. Intercept the special assault force and stop its advance.

HG Astray Red Frame Kai Backpack (Main Machine)
HG Schwert Gewehr (Main Machine)

This mission is to destroy the last remaining main enemy machine
inside the colony. The target is the core of the enemy's strength inside
the colony: an all-round, ultra-high-performance machine with double
rifles and double sabers, powerful beam cannons and railguns, and even
all-range attacks. It will certainly be a hard fight. Come fully prepared.

HG Strike Freedom Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
HG Super Lacerta Beam Saber (Giant Main Machine)

A bonus mission with special settings. Search for and find a Data Probe
that drifted into "a world other than this one" again, and defend it from
enemy forces invading across time and space. This time the enemy is
built around full psycho-frame machines. Take their powerful part
runners and prepare for the final stage of the war that draws near.

HG Strike Freedom Gundam Parts (Unidentified Machine)
HG Banshee (Destroy Mode) Parts (Main Machine)

An emergency. Two extremely powerful energy signals suddenly appeared
and were confirmed descending toward Earth, near the desert area.
They're probably machines far stronger than anything before. Rush to the
desert area, find the first of these signals, which seems to be an
extremely powerful PG machine, and intercept it with everything you have.

HG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
HG 00 Raiser Backpack (Unidentified Machine)

[Special Mission] The other high-energy signal that descended on the
desert area was a giant enemy mobile weapon. This bizarre weapon took
the center of the war zone in one swoop, and with powerful fire and
impregnable defenses it has completely shut down our counterattack. Rush
to the desert area and destroy it before it starts invading other areas!
Defeat the enemy forces around the war zone

At last, the battle at the enemy's main camp! We leave the Earth Sphere's
defense to the main force and charge the enemy base as an independent
unit. First, survey the enemy's strength in this unknown war zone, the
"Forbidden Land". Engage the enemy forces that appear and scout the area.
From here on, we fight alone in enemy territory. Never let your guard down.

HG Beam Scissors (Main Machine)
HG Master Cross (Main Machine)

The enemy has noticed our intrusion and seems to be forming a large
interception force gathering the Gundam-type machines at the heart
of its strength. This mission: wipe out this interception force of
Gundams of every era, and destroy the two main machines leading it.
A battle fit for "the end point of Gundam's history". Give it everything.

HG Arondight (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Rifle (Nu) (Giant Main Machine)

A mission with special settings, in "a world other than this one". Against
an enemy army of Universal Century Gundam machines only, wipe out
their forces and destroy several main enemy machines. Feel the
weighty history of the Universal Century, which began with "Gundam".
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

A mission with special settings, in "a world other than this one".
Against an enemy army of alternate-universe Gundam machines
only, wipe out their forces and destroy several main enemy
machines. Feel the variety of the worlds that grew out of "Gundam".
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

HG Twin Buster Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
HG God Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)

The enemy seems to be getting serious about stopping us at last. From
here on it'll be one fierce, hard battle after another. Give it everything!
This mission is to destroy a tag team of psycho-frame main enemy
machines: the Nu Gundam and the Unicorn Gundam. Watch out for
high-mobility disruption, accurate and powerful fire, and all-range attacks!

HG Hyper Mega Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Magnum (Giant Main Machine)

This mission is to destroy a tag team of main enemy machines with
powerful melee weapons: Astray Red Frame Kai and 00 Raiser.
The Red Frame Kai's dual blades, the 00 Raiser's two kinds of GN
Swords and all kinds of secondary weapons will rain slashes on
you. Pay close attention to melee range and break through them!

HG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
HG Gerbera Straight/Tiger Pierce (Giant Main Machine)

This mission is to destroy a tag team of main enemy machines with
powerful martial-arts attacks: God Gundam and Master Gundam! Fighter
machines with fast, powerful melee moves, yet they also master
area-type special moves that work from a distance: fearsome opponents.
Watch out for their combos and charge attacks, and destroy them!

HG Heat Rod (Epyon) (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Machine Gun (X Divider) (Unidentified Machine)

Destroy two of the very strongest main enemy machines: Strike
Freedom Gundam and 00 Raiser! Both are fearsome, with
high-performance ranged and melee attacks and devastating finishers.
This operation is optional. Take it on if you're confident in your skills.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

HG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
HG Super Lacerta Beam Saber (Giant Main Machine)
Destroy the main enemy machine guarding the gate

At last, the entrance to the space-time gate leading to the heart of the
enemy base has been found! Whatever rules the enemy forces is likely
hiding beyond it. The gate is sealed by an energy field created by two main
enemy machines. Destroy these gatekeepers... the two Master Gundams!
The time of the final battle seems near at last. Give it everything!

HG Master Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Machine Gun (Geara Doga) (Unidentified Machine)
Destroy the giant machine at the enemy core

At last, the attack route into the heart of the enemy base has
opened before us! We will now storm the core area of the enemy
base and destroy the ultra-high- energy source inside, probably a
giant machine! If it succeeds, this should be our last operation.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

[Final Mission]
As a selected player, take part in the exhibition
battle that closes Gundam Great Front.
*In multiplayer (online), clearing this mission
　 automatically disbands the party and returns to the title screen.

HG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
HG Beam Gatling Gun (Giant Main Machine)

Back to basics: a mission to destroy the PG Gundam in the Jungle Base
area. But more MG machines appear than in the previous version's
mission, and the PG machine is an enhanced version customized for
this version by a pro modeler, different from the original. Go in thinking
it's the same as before and you'll regret it. Stay sharp.

MG Armor Schneider (Giant Main Machine)
MG Gatling Shield (Giant Main Machine)
Destroy several main enemy machines in a row

In the same format as the "Final Mission" on the last day of Gundam Great
Front, take on the main enemy machines that appear one after another. The
main machines are the Gundam, the Gundam Mk-II and the Zeta Gundam.
New this time, HG and MG machines also appear alongside the main
machines. It'll be quite a melee, but with your skills you should enjoy it.

MG Beam Saber (Mk-II) (Giant Main Machine)
MG Beam Rifle (Mk-II) (Giant Main Machine)

A mission to destroy the 1/60 scale Nu Gundam at the space fortress. The
enemy interception force in the vanguard is chosen to match the world
where the Nu Gundam fought, and many machines with funnels appear. Get
through the storm of all-range attacks from the MG Sazabi, MG Nu Gundam
and more, and destroy the enhanced 1/60 scale Nu Gundam beyond them.

MG Nu Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
MG Hi-Nu Gundam Backpack (Unidentified Machine)

This time you fight enemy forces made of G Gundam and Gundam W
machines. Break through the powerful melee and ranged combos of the
hero duo, MG God Gundam and MG Wing Gundam Zero (EW), and the varied
waves of attacks from distinctive machines, then destroy this mission's
main enemy machine: the enhanced 1/60 scale Wing Gundam Zero (EW).

MG Twin Buster Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
MG Beam Axe (Unidentified Machine)

This time, a mission modeled on the battles of the Cosmic Era. The
Strike Gundam appears in its Aile, Sword, Launcher and IWSP forms,
along with many powerful fakes built through customization. The
final target is the main enemy machine, the PG Strike Rouge. Watch
how its attacks change as it swaps Striker Packs, and destroy it.

MG Launcher Strike Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
MG Sword Strike Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
Destroy the 1/60 Astray Red Frame Kai

This mission features every machine of the Astray series. The Astray Red
Frame, Blue Frame and Green Frame, their advanced forms Red Frame Kai
and Blue Frame Second Revise, and customized fakes as leader machines
appear. The objective is the enhanced 1/60 scale Astray Red Frame Kai.

MG Gerbera Straight (Giant Main Machine)
MG Gerbera Straight/Tiger Pierce (Giant Main Machine)

A mission where MG versions of the strongest alternate-universe
Gundams attack: Freedom and Strike Freedom, 00 and Susanowo. Each
alone is as strong as a main machine so far, and a storm of attacks
from customized fake units joins them. Survive the fierce battle!

MG 00 Raiser Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
MG Super Lacerta Beam Saber (Giant Main Machine)

A mission where powerful enemy forces built around the
psycho-frame machines Unicorn Gundam, Banshee and Sinanju
attack. The MG Unicorn Gundam and MG Banshee in Destroy
Mode are especially dangerous. Engage them with great care. The
objective is to destroy the enhanced 1/60 scale Unicorn Gundam.

MG Beam Magnum (Giant Main Machine)
MG Astray Red Frame Kai Backpack (Unidentified Machine)

This time, a concept mission themed on a casino stage. Inspired
by roulette, defend the Data Probe from fierce mixed attacks by
enemy forces split into a Black team and a Red team. Earn Ace
Points and a golden bonus enemy force appears too. The
mission is far from easy, but we hope you enjoy the atmosphere.

MG Master Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)
MG Beam Axe (Main Machine)

A concept mission that puts HG-size machines at the center again. Many
of the very strongest HG machines appear, and you fight while constantly
shrunk by Jammer: Scale. Remember how scary HG machines can be.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

MG MA-M21KF High-Energy Beam Rifle (Unidentified Machine)
MG Beam Ribbon (Main Machine)

A mission against an enhanced Apsalus II, a large Mobile Armor. Unlike
the past special mission, you must wipe out the front-line enemy forces to
reach the objective on the mountain base summit. The enemy is mainly
One Year War machines: Zaku, Dom, GM, a Ground Type-style Gundam
and more. Enjoy the feel of a "fierce battle on the snowy mountain".

This time, a concept mission themed on a Gunpla workbench. Defend the
Data Probe against enemy forces made of custom machines that modelers
built themselves. The enemies mix all kinds of machine parts, so you likely
can't tell their strength by their looks. Stay alert against every enemy.

A concept mission with only fighter machines. Centered on martial-arts
machines like God Gundam and Master Gundam, every enemy comes
at you in close combat relying on raw machine power. Take them on
with a fighter-type machine yourself for a different kind of play.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

MG God Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)
MG Beam Saber (Unicorn) (Unidentified Machine)
Destroy several main enemy machines in a row

Destroy main enemy machines with powerful melee and ranged attacks,
one after another: the Strike Gundam switching between Launcher and
Sword, the dual-blade Red Frame Kai and the Wing Gundam Zero (EW)
with its Twin Buster Rifle. At the end, two enhanced ones appear at once.
*Special rule: No return. The mission fails if your machine is disabled.

MG Gerbera Straight (Giant Main Machine)
MG Twin Buster Rifle (Giant Main Machine)

A mission against an enhanced version of the large Mobile Armor
Gells-Ghe. In the desert area, engage and wipe out the enemy
forces on the front line, then fight the objective deep in the war
zone. The enemy forces are modeled on powerful machines from
the Cosmic Era. Enjoy the feel of a "battle of destiny".

MG Arondight (Unidentified Machine)
MG Freedom Gundam Backpack (Unidentified Machine)
The Data Probe is destroyed or <c05>your machine is disabled</c>

A high-difficulty defense mission: protect the Data Probe in the
underground corridor area of the "Forbidden Land" from extremely powerful
enemy forces. The assault force calls to mind the fires of the underworld:
red machines, including many rivals from the original works. Watch out
especially for the MG Sazabi with funnels and the high-mobility MG Sinanju.

MG Gerbera Straight (Giant Main Machine)
MG Gerbera Straight/Tiger Pierce (Giant Main Machine)

A mission against enemy forces of machines with powerful heavy
weapons and solid-round and explosive attacks. Survive a terrifying
battlefield swept by bazooka shells and missile pod blasts. The objective
is the enhanced 1/60 scale Master Gundam, which uses the Darkness
Finger with its fierce explosive finish, and the Chokyu Haow Den-eidan.

MG Master Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)
MG Astray Red Frame Kai Backpack (Unidentified Machine)
Destroy the PG Strike Freedom Gundam

A mission against forces of machines with powerful beam
attacks. Survive a stormy battlefield where countless beams fly,
from fast rifle fire to large- caliber beam cannons. The objective
is the enhanced PG Strike Freedom Gundam. Watch out for its
varied ranged attacks and Full Burst, which combines them all.

MG Strike Freedom Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
MG Super Lacerta Beam Saber (Giant Main Machine)

A mission against enemy forces built around machines with axes and
great swords, known for their rough attacks. Survive a hellish
battlefield where area-type EX- Actions hit you one after another.
The objective is the enhanced PG 00 Raiser. Watch out for the Raiser
Sword, which destroys everything in one hit, and Trans- Am Burst.

MG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
MG Arondight (Leader Machine)
The Data Probe is destroyed or <c05>your machine is disabled</c>

A defense mission themed on a model workbench again. Defend the
Data Probe from attacks by enemy forces built around powerful custom
machines that modelers made themselves. Every enemy combines
parts from high-end machines, with high base performance and
powerful weapons. Stay alert against every one and give it everything.

MG Twin Buster Rifle (Main Machine)
MG Beam Scissors (Main Machine)

A mission against an enhanced Shamblo, a super-giant Mobile Armor. A
special elite force leads the way, centered on blue machines with quietly
brilliant records in the original works and including Gundam types. Engage
and wipe out this elite force, then destroy the giant objective that
appears: the enhanced Shamblo, with stronger armor and extra weapons.

MG Heat Rod (Epyon) (Unidentified Machine)
MG Astray Blue Frame Second Revise Backpack (Leader Machine)

A mission where rival machines form units and both attack at once. Try
breaking through unknown combined attacks as a unit of charismatic
hero machines joins up with a unit of the rival machines that threatened
them. The goal of this mission is to destroy the master-and-student
duo: the enhanced 1/60 scale God Gundam and Master Gundam.

MG God Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)
MG Master Gundam Arm (Giant Main Machine)

A mission where the hero Gundams of every era appear one after another.
This time they appear in new formations beyond era and world, making
the most of each machine. Try breaking through their varied and powerful
combined attacks. The final objective is a tag team of the newest Gundam
types: the enhanced PG 00 Raiser and the 1/60 scale Unicorn Gundam.

MG GN Sword III (Giant Main Machine)
MG Beam Magnum (Giant Main Machine)
Destroy several main enemy machines in a row

The ultimate mission: destroy enhanced versions of the Gundams
of every era, one after another. All the enhanced main enemy
machines appear two at a time. They are "Gundam + Zeta
Gundam", "Nu Gundam + Unicorn Gundam", "God Gundam + Wing
Gundam Zero (EW)", and "Strike Freedom Gundam + 00 Raiser".

MG Twin Buster Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
MG Hyper Mega Rifle (Giant Main Machine)
Destroy the enhanced Grand Master Gundam

A mission against an enhanced version of the Grand Master Gundam. In the
otherworldly area, engage and wipe out the black machines, vanguard of
darkness guarding it, then destroy the objective that appears. The enhanced
Grand Master Gundam is much stronger in both attack and defense, and has
new attacks too. Survive the deadly battle and come back alive.

A new white enemy machine has been spotted entering the Jungle
Base area. With a mustache-like ornament on its head, it seems
connected to the Gundam, but what it is and what it can do are
completely unknown. There are also reports of a separate, powerful
Unidentified Machine. Engage them and find out what they are.

Allies defending a mining facility in the desert area are under assault
by a new machine with a large beam cannon of overwhelming power.
Head to the desert area at night and stop its advance. When it fires,
the reflectors on its back spread into an X shape. Get in the line of
fire and it's over. Watch the enemy closely and strike before it shoots!

HG Gundam X Backpack (Main Machine)
HG Turn A Gundam Body (Unidentified Machine)

Pushed onto the defensive by our main force, the enemy garrison at the
space fortress seems to have called on mysterious space pirates for help.
The pirates' machines use unique close-combat weapons, and their leaders
wear beam-coated mantles. Wipe out the remaining enemy forces and the
space pirates, and finish off the main enemy machine beyond them.

HG Nu Gundam Backpack (Giant Main Machine)
HG Destiny Gundam Backpack (Unidentified Machine)

New heavyweight enemy machines have been confirmed in the space
fortress area: a heavily armed Gundam type and what looks like an
advanced Dom. The Gundam type teams up with Gundams of the same line
and is destroying our allies one after another with high mobility and
firepower. Engage the elite enemy forces including these and destroy them!

HG ZZ Gundam Head (Main Machine)
HG Build Strike Gundam Parts (Unidentified Machine)

To find a route to the heart of the enemy base, where whatever
commands the enemy is thought to be, we will gather intel inside the
"Forbidden Land". With no allies and little time, our squad alone must
defend the Data Probes in several areas. When each finishes collecting
data, move on to the next area and defend every Data Probe.

HG Gundam X Backpack (Main Machine)
HG Beam Rifle (Turn A) (Main Machine)

A mission in the desert area against machines from the First Neo Zeon War.
Led by the ZZ Gundam with its High Mega Cannon, an irregular Gundam team
including the Qubeley Mk-II and desert-spec Zeon machines appear. The
main enemy machines are the Gundam Mk-II and an enhanced Zeta Gundam.

MG ZZ Gundam Head (Unidentified Machine)
MG Beam Tomahawk (Dreissen) (Main Machine)

An annihilation mission in the Jungle Base area at night, bathed in
moonlight. Break through front-line forces of ground-combat machines,
like One Year War Zeon machines and G Gundam fighters, and destroy
